label: completes
type: the subject statement finishes an operation that the object statement began but deliberately left unfinished.
note: BUILD INDEX completes a CREATE INDEX issued with the DEFER BUILD option. Two files, both in server/7.2, one of which had already flagged it as 'reused, still watchlist' - so it recurred across pages without any prompting. Name is generic; definition is narrow (a two-phase operation split across two statements) and should stay that way.
